scope: PF-06 ICE policy configuration increment independent review

changeSnapshot.worktree: existing shared PF-06 WIP; no commit, stage, reset, clean, or push performed by acceptance

checks.evidence: RemoteAssistanceOptions and MediaBindingDto default IcePolicy to canonical All, matching detailed specification section 1.3.
GetNormalizedIcePolicy accepts the supported values case-insensitively and returns only canonical All or RelayOnly; Bind returns that canonical value to the frontend.
RelayOnly requires at least one TURN/TURNS URL and a credential secret; otherwise MEDIA_ICE_CONFIGURATION is raised.
TURN/TURNS entries under All also require the secret and receive short-lived coturn REST credentials; non-TURN entries do not receive credentials.
TTL defaults to 300 seconds and is clamped to 30-3600 seconds; the configured signing secret is used only for HMAC generation and is not returned in the DTO.
Policy normalization and ICE server generation run before MediaContextRegistry.Bind, so an ICE configuration exception occurs before context mutation.
MEDIA_ICE_CONFIGURATION maps to dedicated Chinese and English administrator-facing ICE/TURN guidance while retaining the technical code.

reviewDefect.problem: The provider originally accepted RelayOnly case-insensitively while Bind returned the raw configured string and the frontend compared it case-sensitively. Non-canonical casing could therefore make the browser allow direct candidates.
reviewDefect.repair: The policy is now normalized once to canonical All or RelayOnly before ICE generation and MediaContext mutation, and the canonical value is returned by Bind.
reviewDefect.regressionCoverage: Application_RemoteAssistanceBindConcurrencyTests contains lowercase and uppercase RelayOnly cases and asserts the Bind DTO returns RelayOnly.

finalDelivery: Fresh Release build reported exit code 0 with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
ICE provider and Bind policy tests reported 7/7 passing after the normalization repair.
Frontend media error tests reported 3/3 passing.
developerVerification.acceptanceNote: Per dispatch, acceptance did not rerun those commands. The final policy-normalization repair and its two-case Bind contract test were independently inspected against the frozen source; command results remain developer-reported evidence.
